title: Player-Team Discrepancy: Byron Young LAR vs PHI
description: Byron Young was listed under PHI by ESPN injuries JSON but LAR by nfl.com official report. Cross-validated against official gamebook and resolved to LAR.
resolution: Resolved to LAR official league affiliation.

title: Reddit JSON API Access Blocked (HTTP 403)
description: Automated unauthenticated requests to Reddit JSON endpoints return HTTP 403 Forbidden since platform rate gate updates in 2026.
resolution: Documented in Data Registry; strategy research transitioned to verified GitHub/NOAA/nflverse mirrors.

title: TNF Indoor vs Outdoor Weather Attribution
description: Outdoor weather stations for domed stadiums report outdoor barometric pressure that does not affect climate-controlled turf field conditions.
resolution: Flagged is_dome flag to strictly enforce wind speed = 0.0 mph for indoor venues.

title: NFL Personnel Policy PDFs Return 404
description: operations.nfl.com policy PDFs returned 404 to HTTP fetcher despite being search-indexed.
resolution: Replaced evidence links with verified active nfl.com/injuries canonical endpoint.

title: Kalshi Orderbook Depth Re-anchoring Between Snapshots
description: Kalshi orderbook ladders are captured periodically; between snapshots depth is re-anchored to the last verified quoted touch.
resolution: Bounded simulated fills by real historical volume and 500 contract size limits to prevent unrealistic fill assumptions.

title: Offensive Line Continuity Tracking Limited Pre-2018
description: OL continuity tracking and pressure stats only available from 2018 onward via PFR advanced stats mirror. Pre-2018 games use fallback continuity = 5.
resolution: Documented as known limitation; OL strategies flagged as BACKTESTED from 2018 onward, FORWARD_TEST for full validation.

title: Historical Player Prop Lines Not in Free Archive
description: Historical player prop lines (receiving yards, rushing yards, receptions) not in nflverse free archive; require paid Odds API or DraftKings archive. Prop strategies classified as FORWARD_TEST.
resolution: Prop strategies use role-based projections and are forward-tested on 2026 slate; historical backtest simulated with proxy team totals.

title: Alternate Spreads Historical Archive Limited
description: Alternate spreads (+/- 3 pts from main) not in nflverse historical; only main spread available. Alt strategies forward-test only.
resolution: Flagged as FORWARD_TEST; uses Poisson tail probabilities for fair value.

title: Live Play-by-Play Latency & Verification
description: Live win probability strategies require sub-second play-by-play; ESPN hidden API provides real-time but unofficial contract. Live strategies forward-test only until official live feed verified.
resolution: Live strategies marked FORWARD_TEST with WATCHING status for 2026 Week 2.

title: Travel Distance Coordinate Mapping Approximation
description: Stadium coordinates for travel fatigue model use approximate centroids; actual team travel may include layovers, not direct stadium-to-stadium.
resolution: Haversine distance used as proxy; flagged as approximation, not exact travel.

title: Dossier claim refuted by the snapshot: Home cover rate, Thursday with visitor on <=4 days rest
description: data/research_experiments.json declares 58.1; recomputing from the games.csv snapshot gives 51.24 across the stated sample.
resolution: Both values retained. The dossier entry is marked DISPUTED_BY_SNAPSHOT and its numbers are not quoted in published prose; no side is silently overwritten.
